title: Lyft and Baidu enter London’s robotaxi battleground as testing begins
summary: Baidu's Apollo Go autonomous vehicles will operate in London through Freenow, the mobility platform Lyft acquired in 2025, marking a major expansion of robotaxi services in a competitive European market.
content: Baidu's Apollo Go autonomous vehicles will be available on Freenow, the mobility network that Lyft acquired in 2025.

zh.title: Lyft与百度进军伦敦无人驾驶出租车市场，测试启动
zh.summary: 百度的Apollo Go自动驾驶车辆将通过Lyft 2025年收购的出行平台Freenow在伦敦运营，标志着无人驾驶出租车服务在竞争激烈的欧洲市场实现重大扩展。

title: Cursor makes its biggest India push yet ahead of SpaceX acquisition with localized pricing
summary: Cursor is expanding aggressively in India, now its third-largest market globally, with plans to hire locally and grow enterprise sales ahead of its SpaceX acquisition announcement.
content: Cursor says India is now its third-largest market globally and plans to expand local hiring and enterprise sales.

zh.title: Cursor在SpaceX收购前推出本地化定价策略，印度市场实现最大规模扩张
zh.summary: Cursor在印度市场积极扩张，该市场已成为其全球第三大市场，计划在宣布SpaceX收购前进行本地招聘并扩大企业销售。

title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei responds: doesn’t oppose open-weight models, but fears Chinese AI
summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei clarified his position on open-weight AI models, stating opposition isn't to their existence but to concerns about China's advancing AI capabilities. This reflects broader industry concerns about geopolitical competition in AI development.
content: Anthropic founder and CEO Dario Amodei made his views clear about open-weight models and China's growing AI capabilities.

zh.title: Anthropic的Dario Amodei回应：不反对开放权重模型，但担心中国AI
zh.summary: Anthropic首席执行官Dario Amodei澄清了他对开源权重AI模型的立场，声称他的反对不是针对这些模型的存在，而是对中国AI能力提升的担忧。这反映了整个行业对AI发展中地缘政治竞争的担忧。
